rationale: Third-party child injured due to hazardous condition (ice) on the policyholder's premise during an ice storm, creating a clear premises liability exposure.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's daughter slipped on icy walkway in front of policyholder's house during last week's ice storm and broke her wrist. Parents are discussing medical bills. This is a high-severity pediatric injury claim requiring prompt investigation of premises conditions and medical cost documentation.

case_facts.description: Child slipped and fell on icy walkway; broke wrist
